formulas.ascii: p[k] = sphericalInterpolate(a, b, theta, k/n); m[k] = R*theta*k/n, k=0..n. theta is the Vincenty-form spherical central angle. n is the capped maximum of the requested length subdivision and minimumSegments (at least 1). Endpoints are copied exactly, with target longitude unwrapped from a; coincident arcs use normalized linear blending. The shared interpolator preserves fractions 0 and 1 even for antipodes; interior fractions within 1e-6 radians of an antipode are NaN. No whole-arc rejection is performed: counts and endpoints are still emitted when an interior vertex is NaN. Near-antipodal interpolation outside the 1e-6 guard can still be numerically unstable; split such arcs in the caller.
